title: The Lotus Sutra (Fall Class Part 3)
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher invites participants to explore the contrast between two types of experiences: one that evokes a sense of solidity and permanence, and another that is ephemeral and fleeting. By imagining themselves in each scenario, participants can notice how their emotional tone changes and what they find beautiful or inspiring about each experience. This exercise encourages us to cultivate awareness of impermanence and the importance of embracing both stability and fluidity in our lives.
